description: Definitions of the four exposure levels (prudent, equilibre, risque, advanced): size of your copies, leaders, exposure cap, drawdown alerts, plans, minPracticalBalanceUsd. With equity (USDC) or a session_token (your Hyperliquid balance): recommendedLevel, the most prudent of prudent, equilibre, risque whose minimum balance the equity covers (1,100 / 550 / 300 USDC), with recommendationNote; under every minimum, risque with belowAllMinimums: true (copies under Hyperliquid's minimum order open at 11 USDC; risque stays closest to the leaders' proportions). advanced is never recommended. No session needed.

equity.description: Balance in USDC to get a recommendation for; default: the signed-in account's balance
